title: Chiku Learns to Save
moral: Preparing ahead helps you in difficult times.

scenes.summary: Chiku the squirrel loves playing but does not like saving food.
scenes.text:
Chiku the Squirrel Who Forgot to Save

In a tall oak tree in a busy forest, lived a little squirrel named Chiku.

Chiku loved to play all day.

He jumped from branch to branch, chased butterflies, and nibbled on nuts.

But there was one thing Chiku did not like…

Saving food.

scenes.summary: Chiku ignores warnings about saving food for winter and chooses to play instead.
scenes.text:
Every autumn, the other squirrels gathered nuts and stored them.

“Winter is coming,” said Mili the Squirrel.

“We need to save food.”

But Chiku laughed.

“There are so many nuts everywhere!” he said.

Day after day, Chiku ate his nuts happily.

scenes.summary: Winter arrives, and Chiku realizes he has no food and feels hungry.
scenes.text:
Soon, the weather changed.

Cold winds blew.

Snow covered the ground.

All the trees became bare.

Chiku looked around.

“No nuts?” he said.

He searched everywhere.

Nothing.

Chiku’s tummy rumbled.

“I’m so hungry,” he said.

He felt cold and tired.

“I should have saved some food,” he whispered.
scenes.image_prompt: sad squirrel in snowy forest searching for food with empty ground, winter cartoon style

scenes.summary: Chiku’s friends help him and he learns the importance of saving.
scenes.text:
Just then, Mili came by.

“Chiku, are you okay?” she asked.

“I’m hungry,” Chiku said sadly.

Mili smiled kindly.

“Come with us. We saved extra food.”

Chiku’s eyes lit up.

“Really?”

The squirrels shared their nuts with Chiku.

He felt warm and happy again.

“Thank you,” he said.

“I learned my lesson.”

It’s important to prepare for the future.

A little effort today can help you tomorrow.

The End

story:
Chiku the Squirrel Who Forgot to Save

In a tall oak tree in a busy forest, lived a little squirrel named Chiku.

Chiku loved to play all day.

He jumped from branch to branch, chased butterflies, and nibbled on nuts.

But there was one thing Chiku did not like…

Saving food.

Every autumn, the other squirrels gathered nuts and stored them.

“Winter is coming,” said Mili the Squirrel.

“We need to save food.”

But Chiku laughed.

“There are so many nuts everywhere!” he said.

“Why save them? I’ll just eat them now!”

Day after day, Chiku ate his nuts happily.

Crunch! Crunch!

While others worked hard, Chiku played.

“Come play with me!” he called.

But the others were busy preparing for winter.

Soon, the weather changed.

Cold winds blew.

Snow covered the ground.

All the trees became bare.

Chiku looked around.

“No nuts?” he said.

He searched everywhere.

Nothing.

Chiku’s tummy rumbled.

“I’m so hungry,” he said.

He felt cold and tired.

“I should have saved some food,” he whispered.

Just then, Mili came by.

“Chiku, are you okay?” she asked.

“I’m hungry,” Chiku said sadly.

Mili smiled kindly.

“Come with us. We saved extra food.”

Chiku’s eyes lit up.

“Really?”

The squirrels shared their nuts with Chiku.

He felt warm and happy again.

“Thank you,” he said.

“I learned my lesson.”

It’s important to prepare for the future.

A little effort today can help you tomorrow.

The End
